svg.text: JS18215 - explained class: AF (model-predicted; ground-truth label PRESENT)
pre-sigmoid logit 1.20 (probability 0.768); zero baseline logit -7.83; IG completeness error 5.45% of f(x)-f(baseline). Thresholds were selected on this fold.
A. Preprocessed (filtered, z-scored) 12-lead input with the 4 highest-attribution 250 ms windows shaded
B. Integrated Gradients, signed (red: raises the logit, blue: lowers it), lead x time (20-sample blocks)
colour scale: +/-0.182 logit units per 20-sample block (99.5th percentile of |block|)
High attribution marks where the MODEL's logit is sensitive along the integration path; it does not establish a physiological cause. Windows are not labelled with any ECG feature.
